_comment: Professor Adow TVET — school-level constants, read by tools/generate-adow-catalog.js and tools/upload-adow-to-bunny.js. This school is hosted by eduplatform but is NOT under Ehel Academy: its own storage zone, its own catalogue, its own consumer record in Moodle. See docs/professor-adow-tvet-setup-plan.md. The three TODO values below are Phase 0 decisions; the uploader refuses to run while any of them still says TODO.
name: Professor Adow TVET
_storage: Phase 0. The zone is created in the Bunny dashboard; the key is that zone's own password and goes in .env as BUNNY_TVET_KEY — never Ehel's BUNNY_KEY and never Quraan's generic BUNNY_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY.
_departments: Order here is the order departments appear in the catalogue. A department earns a Moodle category only when it has at least one course whose course-manifest.json exists.
